title: Paris
sideASummary: Infection deck back. Biohazard art. No printed text.
sideBSummary: Paris Infection card. Blue Europe map, city name down the left edge, white center panel, green ring. No coordinates and no special rule. P4-06b.

rules: Blue Infection card for Paris. Two copies share this face.
The white center panel is the infection-card improvement slot. The green ring is standard infection-card art.
No extra effect is printed. Drawing it infects Paris by the usual infection rules.
notes: Both copies print P4-06b. No separate P4-05b scan is in this package.
The recon report puts both copies in the Game End area, so Paris is not infected from the deck when the package is opened.
